rev6.release_notes: Simulate's view cube no longer shows a note when the mouse is over it. The add-in for your CAD software is updated with it (close that program before updating).

cadcam.release_notes: New setups are named OP1, OP2, OP3. Drag toolpaths and setups in the Browser to change their order, and copy / paste them with Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V; a separated toolpath shows a symbol. 2D Pocket picks a pocket when you click inside it; every pick row has a trash can, and clicking a pick again unpicks it. The Setup window has a Work holding section at the bottom and Z0 on a clicked face. The Post window's first button opens the program in G-SEND.IO's code editor. Tool Library is now Tools. New app and Setup icons, clearer feature previews, better lighting on shared simulations.
